title: Strapi: attackers can read data they should not see
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed, but the vulnerability is more than a year old and we see no ransomware use, public attack tools, internet-facing product, critical severity or high prediction score. Check whether it applies to you.

category.label: Website or online store
category.why: It runs public websites, online stores or the software behind them.
category.doThis: Ask whoever runs your website or store to update it.

summary: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 11, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
